items.source_en:
Genghis somehow got a hold of explosives. Last night we woke to a thunderous din.

The Facility has been repeating incessantly: Containment Breached. It is maddening.

An expedition was sent to the outside this morning, they report predators... deadly ones, all about.

Amelia and Amanirenas are furiously working to come up with anything that could be used as a weapon. I tried to get into the Facility's inner sanctum - to no avail.

There is nowhere to hide. Nothing to be done but wait.
